newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-INJURED BECKER PULLS OUT OF STUTTGART TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED BECKER PULLS OUT OF STUTTGART TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Boris Becker pulled out of the Stuttgart clay-court tournament because of a knee injury on Thursday, minutes before the start of his scheduled third-round match with Spaniard Albert Costa.

Becker, playing his first tournament after his emotional farewell to Wimbledon two weeks ago, said his knee had been bothering him since his quarter-final defeat to Pete Sampras at the All England Club.

"It's been worrying me for the last two weeks and it was hurting during my match yesterday (Wednesday)," said Becker, referring to his victory over Moroccan Karim Alami in his first match since Wimbledon. "Suddenly, this (Thursday) morning, it became worse."
Becker said last week he would enter the upcoming U.S. Open championships, ending speculation that his Wimbledon appearance could have been his last at a Grand Slam event.
He said on Wednesday that he would make himself available for Davis Cup duties next year.
